owner_decisions.weights: the accepted six-system v2 weights (handoff section 2)
owner_decisions.pmi_substitute: Philadelphia Fed manufacturing general activity index (FRED GACDFSA066MSFRBPHI) in place of ISM manufacturing PMI, which is licensed and no longer on FRED
owner_decisions.scoring: continuous: each v1 neutral band becomes a straight ramp from -1 at its expansion edge to +1 at its stress edge; beyond the band the v1 score holds
owner_decisions.oil: overlay only (inflation_energy_shock); not in RSI v2.0
owner_decisions.housing: no separate housing opportunity score; the Housing Intelligence Platform's V11 cards and rate outlook are reused

claims.unit: initial claims (4-week avg) per 1,000 payroll jobs
claims.v1: <220k -1; 220-260k 0; >260k +1. Scaled by payroll employment so the thresholds mean the same thing across decades: 1.38 and 1.63 per 1,000 jobs are 220k and 260k at about 159.5 million jobs.

unemployment.unit: percentage points (3-month average above its 12-month low)
unemployment.v1: qualitative 'unemployment change'; the Sahm-rule reading triggers at 0.5

post_inversion_floor.why: a curve that has just un-inverted is not low risk: for 24 months after the last inverted month the score cannot fall below neutral

fallback.why: Moody's Baa minus 10-year, used only for months the high-yield series does not cover

manufacturing.v1: PMI >52 -1; 48-52 0; <48 +1. The Philly index swings about three times as far as the ISM around its neutral point, so +/-2 PMI points become +/-6.

housing.unit: building permits, 3-month average, % change on a year earlier

m2.unit: M2, % change on a year earlier

sp500_trend.unit: S&P 500 month-end close vs its 10-month average, %

inflation_energy_shock.unit: WTI crude, % change on a year earlier

bands_status: provisional heuristic labels from v1, not measured recession frequencies

coverage.rule: a missing or stale component's weight is shared across the present components of its system; the headline is suppressed below 80% coverage

recession_probability.why: uncalibrated until a walk-forward model passes (handoff 4B)
